component.name: NeedMoreBench
component.summary: Language models play mafia while you watch, meddle or play
언어 모델들의 마피아 게임을 관전하고 끼어들고 함께 하기

description.p: Language models sit at one table and play a game of hidden roles: they talk, accuse, lie and vote. You watch every word and thought, step in with god powers, or take a seat yourself.

Every game is saved. Replay it move by move, export it, and see how each model does over many games. Bring your own models: OpenCode free models, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Venice or LM Studio on your computer.
